THE PALMA
One a year. The whole palm, four frond pairs,and the crown held clear on a tapered needle.Bronze, on a turned bronze seal. 2.9 kg.
CATEGORY PALMA
The same palm, no crown. That is the wholehierarchy, and it reads across a room.1.4 kg.
PLAN
Cruciform. One set of fronds in the plane of the mark, a second at ninety degrees to it. Head-on you see the logo exactly. From anywhere else you see a palm, not a cutout of one.
Socketed deep into the seal, so what shows below the lowest fronds is a hand's width and not a bare stalk. MILLIMETRES
